title: Query-time evidence synthesis over BM25 for LLM agent memory: preregistered LongMemEval-S study
description: Code, preregistrations, cached rows and technical report. A cheap query-conditioned LLM pass over BM25 top-40 lifts LongMemEval-S multi-session accuracy from 22/57 to 27-30/57 (blind gpt-4o-mini judge); structured state not shown to beat free-form notes; more BM25 context does not help. Includes negative results.
